sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. ONE UNIT, no fan-out. Frozen seam: (1) crates/core/src/delivery.rs select_rung — the Pointer arm becomes a BODY-typing rung (rename honestly, e.g. TypedBody); its guard conditions are UNCHANGED (pane present, no socket, composer idle, no typing veto). (2) crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs drain path — where announce_pointer runs today, submit the FULL framed body via TmuxPort::submit; body comes from the queue row it already claims. (3) Framing via crates/core/src/framing.rs ONLY (one-artifact-one-formatter). (4) The >1022B hazard: TmuxPort::submit today types via send-keys; coder MUST probe the real limit live and either chunk with verification or switch the adapter to tmux load-buffer+paste-buffer — decision recorded with the probe output in the plan assets. (5) Receipts: mint a distinct outcome (e.g. TypedToPane) — do NOT reuse InjectedToTransport (evidence-class: a socket inject is observed by the recipient process, a typed pane is not). CONSTRAINT WITH REASON: the politeness gate stays upstream (permits_injection_fresh) AND its discharge is currently invisible at select_rung's call site (hardcoded false/true at worker.rs:299) — while you are in that file, thread the gate verdict through or comment the discharge; do not add a second gate. STOP-AND-ASK: any need to touch crates/transport/src/uds.rs or the shim routing.

value.rationale: <Why. Rules: SOLO-PM when the work has no parallelizable seams or is small — the PM codes it itself, then runs the reviewer. CODERS when units below can proceed in parallel (or it is multi-phase): 1-n coders per wave, PM composes after each wave, reviewer after composition. The units table is the argument for this decision — if you cannot write independent unit rows with clean interfaces, the answer is solo-pm. Dispatch overhead counts: a unit cheaper than its own dispatch (spawn+canary+ack+review) is not a unit - fold it into a sibling.>

value.name: <unit/service name>
value.responsibility: <one bounded thing this unit does; one domain = one unit = one service page>
value.interface: <the SETTLED contract: pub fns/types/trait it exposes, the config section it is constructed with, the envelope/schema it emits. Coders implement this verbatim; changes are a PM ruling.>
value.test_strategy: <how this unit proves its contract STANDALONE with fakes, and the exact scoped test command (Rust example: `cargo test -p <crate>` + testkit fakes); name the specific cases that must exist. Fix-tests must be mutation-checked (break the code, watch the test fail).>
value.note: <sibling hazards, allow-list rows granted, parked debt folded in>

Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: <Composition is an explicit, separate step — the first-light pattern: everything already exists as tested parts; this is the wiring that makes them one system. Read order = each unit's service page / done report. Steps: merge unit branches in dependency order onto the plan branch → wire at the composition root → make `harness checks` green on the composed tree → run the integration proof. Known composition failure modes to check deliberately: mis-wiring (right parts, wrong plumbing), interface drift from this doc, envelope/schema drift between units, stale doc-comments across fence boundaries. RULE: composition is wiring, not building — if a unit needs INTERNAL rework at compose time, that is a defect in the contracts phase, not a composition task: stop, record it (harness observe + the skill EXPERIENCES.md), and have it ruled before touching the unit.>
value.integration_proof: <the named end-to-end evidence: integration test file(s) and/or a live run transcript captured as the plan's exit evidence>

value.when: after composition (or after solo-pm coding), before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps
